subject: HOLD Cantina identity sampling: mask association/alignment unresolved
body:
Concrete concern from the active root operator: HOLD Cantina identity sampling. The Cloud mask-only job completed, but the downloaded mask labeled frame 69 does not match the manual allowed windows for source F236. Root measured 2,276 pixels exceeding the allowed cap threshold (>1), with a reported maximum of 255. This is a failed/unresolved output check, not proof that the mask belongs to the intended source frame.

Cloud preview frame 4 also says "Image does not exist". Root is investigating export association versus batch decoding/alignment through persistent mask/source video preflight. The cause is not established. Identity generation has not run and remains held until the actual protection/alignment evidence passes.

This is not a billing or approval issue. No user action is requested yet. Existing single-proof bounds remain in force; this notice creates no new assignment. Posted locally only; no Nova Dot reading or wakeup is established.

source.description: Root reports mask-cap comparison and missing Cloud preview, and has placed identity sampling on hold. File writer did not independently inspect the media or browser.
